example.title: Box culvert carrying Spring Creek under 458 Avenue
example.place: northeast of Wakonda, Clay County, SD
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Spring Creek bridge, 458 Avenue (Clay County, South Dakota))

brief: Modern twin-cell precast/cast reinforced-concrete box culvert under a paved county road: two square cells side by side with a plain concrete headwall and flared concrete wing walls with sloped tops, delineator posts at the road edge. Shown in winter snow in open farm country. Fits a growing exurban street crossing (only one photo was retrievable).
